title: bug: add_comment, amend_plan_step and release_task record no actor, so get_activity_log by workerId misses every comment, plan amendment and release, and a release routed to REVIEW reads "Task moved to REVIEW by unknown"
description:
Filed by the 11-03 #2 defect hunt (task-2597ac6f). This is the sibling of task-2e3012b9: same defect class, disjoint files.

PROBLEM
At HEAD 946358a8, three more tools call updateTask without the 4th (actor) argument that task-d981e0b0 (3ba2bddd) added to the review loop:
- tools/addComment.ts:121 `updateTask(..., 'TASK_COMMENT_ADDED')`. The author is recorded only inside the comments payload.
- tools/amendPlanStep.ts:115 `updateTask(..., 'TASK_UPDATED')`. amendedBy is recorded only inside the step payload.
- tools/releaseTask.ts:332 `updateTask(..., 'WORKER_RELEASED')`. Its routing (state/workerLifecycle.ts:109-112) moves an all-steps-done WORKING row to REVIEW, and the refusal cascade moves rows to BACKLOG. That move clears the assignee, so #general reads "by unknown".

tools/getActivityLog.ts:131-132 filters only on the event's top-level workerId. So an audit by a seat or a governor (get_activity_log { workerId }) never sees these events. state/taskStore.ts:643-657 has the details.

EVIDENCE
(a) Repros on HEAD 946358a8, run in a git-archive snapshot under /tmp with Linux node_modules, never in the shared checkout:
- `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntActor2.test.ts` fails 1 test with:
  - "WORKER_RELEASED actor: expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ 'worker-r' ]"
  - "amend TASK_UPDATED actor: expected [ null ] to deeply equal [ 'architect-z' ]"
  - #general received "task-rel: Task moved to REVIEW by unknown"; expected "... by worker-r".
- `npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntActor.test.ts`: the TASK_COMMENT_ADDED actor is null, and get_activity_log { workerId: worker-a } has no TASK_COMMENT_ADDED.
- Files and output:
  - /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/zzHuntActor2.test.ts
  - /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/repro-output-actor2.txt
  - /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/zzHuntActor.test.ts
  - /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-2597/repro-output-actor.txt

(b) Today's logs (.moe/activity.log plus activity.log.1.gz) come from the live daemon edc27e14; this code is unchanged at 946358a8. All 59 of today's TASK_COMMENT_ADDED events carry no workerId. Neither do the five amend_plan_step TASK_UPDATED writes, whose payload is implementationPlan only, for example at 2026-11-03T00:35:17.210Z on task-ecf78687.

FIX DIRECTION
Pass params.workerId as updateTask's 4th argument at the three call sites.
- In release_task, pass params.workerId, NOT actors.actor. releaseActors (util/claimGuards.ts:329-343) returns UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER = 'unknown' (:246) for a release with no caller id, and that string must not land in an event's workerId.
- No schema or MCP contract change.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/addComment.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/amendPlanStep.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/releaseTask.ts
- new test: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/taskEventActor.test.ts. Model it on tools/reviewLoopActor.test.ts.

Out of scope:
- the status-move tools: task-2e3012b9.
- get_context's contextFetchedBy write. It is a read-side bookkeeping write that already names the reader.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md. It is held by task-347dde85, and no doc change is needed.

VERIFICATION
Run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout, per the global rail:
`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/taskEventActor.test.ts src/tools/addComment.test.ts src/tools/amendPlanStep.test.ts src/tools/releaseTask.test.ts`
definitionOfDone: TASK_COMMENT_ADDED, amend_plan_step's TASK_UPDATED and WORKER_RELEASED all carry the calling seat's workerId, and get_activity_log { workerId } returns them for that seat. A release with no caller id records no workerId, never the string 'unknown'.
When the holder calls release_task and it routes WORKING to REVIEW, it posts "Task moved to REVIEW by <releaser>". Calls with no workerId keep today's fallback.
A new daemon test asserts both items above with exact values and fails on HEAD 946358a8. The verification command in the description passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
The fix. Pass the caller's id as updateTask's fourth (actor) argument at four call sites, using the Edit tool. Nothing else in these files changes. The architect's validated diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-e977/fix.diff (9 changed lines); match its formatting so step 4's mutant driver applies cleanly.
- tools/addComment.ts, the updateTask call at :121-125: `'TASK_COMMENT_ADDED',` then `params.workerId` on its own line. Do not pass comment.author: it is 'agent' when no id was sent, and an audit actor is never guessed (state/activityLog.ts:30 appendActivity).
- tools/amendPlanStep.ts :115: `state.updateTask(task.id, { implementationPlan: nextSteps }, 'TASK_UPDATED', params.workerId)`. Do not pass amendment.amendedBy, which falls back to 'unknown'.
- tools/releaseTask.ts :332, the assigned path: `state.updateTask(task.id, updates, 'WORKER_RELEASED', params.workerId)`. Do NOT pass actors.actor. For a release with no caller id, releaseActors (util/claimGuards.ts:329-343) returns UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER = 'unknown' (:246), and that string must not land in an event's workerId (DoD 1). A governor's forced strip records the governor; the stripped holder appears only in the result's strippedFrom and in the banner.
- tools/releaseTask.ts :249, the already-unassigned repair path: `state.updateTask(task.id, repairUpdates, 'WORKER_RELEASED', params.workerId)`. The description cites only :332, but DoD 1 covers every WORKER_RELEASED that release_task writes, and this path also auto-routes WORKING to REVIEW with a 'by unknown' notice. Do not use `params.workerId || UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER`; that expression belongs to the handoff's releasedBy, a different field.

Error handling: the extra argument adds no new IO and no new throw path, so the existing error handling stays exactly as it is and needs no new code. updateTask still throws before any write on a missing task. appendActivity is best-effort and never throws into its caller (a failed audit write is logged, not raised). The 'Task moved to' notice is already posted fire-and-forget with `.catch(() => {})`. release_task's post-write attempt close and chat posts stay best-effort try/catch, so a failure there still never fails a durable release.

Unchanged by design: the tool results (releasedBy, strippedFrom, previousWorkerId), every banner, the comment author, amendedBy, the handoff's releasedBy, updateTask and appendActivity, and docs/MCP_SERVER.md. That doc is held by task-347dde85, and no contract changes.

Out of scope, do not touch:
- the status-move tools (task-2e3012b9);
- the board's comment path (server/WebSocketServer.ts:975), which carries no seat id;
- the daemon-owned writes at delivery/repairActivation.ts:76, state/workerStore.ts:275 and state/workerLifecycle.ts:158;
- unblock_worker (tools/unblockWorker.ts:111). Its workerId names the TARGET seat, so passing it as the actor would be a false attribution.
implementationPlan.note: Used one-shot Serena editor for all four actor argument additions, matching fix.diff formatting. Reused updateTask's existing actor channel; no abstraction, dependency, IO or throw path added. Confirmed params.workerId stays distinct from comment.author and releaseActors' 'unknown' placeholder. All other tool result/banner/handoff fields and existing best-effort error handling unchanged. GREEN and TypeScript checks are batched in approved step 3.

implementationPlan.description:
Verification gate (DoD 3). Run it once, fresh, from the task worktree after the last tracked edit. Its output is the complete_task evidence: command, exitCode 0, and an outputTail holding the snapshot= line and the Test Files/Tests lines. Never run it in the shared checkout (global rail 1). Run exactly:

( set -o pipefail && R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/e977-v.XXXX) && echo "snapshot=$S" && git -C "$R" archive HEAD packages/moe-daemon scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs | tar -x -C "$S" && for f in tools/addComment.ts tools/amendPlanStep.ts tools/releaseTask.ts tools/taskEventActor.test.ts; do cp "$R/packages/moe-daemon/src/$f" "$S/packages/moe-daemon/src/$f" || exit 1; done && cd "$S/packages/moe-daemon" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx tsc --noEmit && printf '{"extends":"./tsconfig.json","compilerOptions":{"noEmit":true,"types":["node"]},"include":["src/tools/taskEventActor.test.ts"],"exclude":[]}' > tt.json && npx tsc -p tt.json && NO_COLOR=1 npx vitest run src/tools/taskEventActor.test.ts src/tools/addComment.test.ts src/tools/amendPlanStep.test.ts src/tools/releaseTask.test.ts src/tools/echoedReasonNotices.test.ts src/tools/getActivityLog.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -15 )

What it does: archives HEAD's packages/moe-daemon plus scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs (needed by the package-wide tsc) into /tmp, overlays this row's four files, runs npm ci, then `tsc --noEmit` for the sources and tt.json for the new test (the package tsconfig excludes tests and vitest does not typecheck; mem:convention-daemon-full-suite-gate-checkref). Then it runs the description's four files, plus echoedReasonNotices.test.ts (the release chat lines) and getActivityLog.test.ts (the workerId query).

The architect dry-ran this exact command from a throwaway repo that held the fix and the prototype test: exit 0, Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 109 passed (109), which is 107 existing plus 2 new. Counts may grow if a peer lands tests in these files; exit 0 is the requirement.

Error handling in the gate: every stage is chained with && inside a pipefail subshell, so a failing archive, cp, npm ci or tsc ends the run with that stage's non-zero code, and vitest's own exit code survives the tail. npm ci prints nothing on failure, because its output goes to /dev/null. If the gate fails silently, rerun npm ci in that snapshot without the redirect to see why. Keep the printed snapshot= path for step 4.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: add_comment, amend_plan_step and both of release_task's WORKER_RELEASED writes record the calling seat's workerId as the event actor (updateTask's 4th argument). get_activity_log { workerId } then returns those events for that seat, and a holder's release routed WORKING to REVIEW posts "Task moved to REVIEW by <releaser>". A call with no workerId records no actor (never 'unknown' or 'agent') and keeps the 'by unknown' notice fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: TASK_COMMENT_ADDED (add_comment), TASK_UPDATED (amend_plan_step) and WORKER_RELEASED (release_task, assigned and already-unassigned paths) carry the caller's workerId, and get_activity_log { workerId } returns each for that seat.
A caller-less add_comment or release_task records no workerId: never 'unknown' (UNIDENTIFIED_RELEASER) and never 'agent' (the comment author placeholder).
A holder's release routed WORKING to REVIEW posts 'Task moved to REVIEW by <releaser>'; a caller-less one keeps 'by unknown'.
tools/taskEventActor.test.ts asserts all of the above with exact values, fails on 946358a8, passes with the fix, and kills all 7 mutants in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-e977/mutants.sh.
invariants: An event's workerId is params.workerId or absent; this change never writes 'unknown' or 'agent' into it.
Tool results, chat banners, the comment author, amendedBy and the handoff's releasedBy are byte-for-byte unchanged.
Error handling is unchanged: no new throw or IO path; appendActivity and the chat posts stay best-effort.
updateTask, appendActivity, getActivityLog, the schema and docs/MCP_SERVER.md are untouched; no MCP contract change.
compatibility: Callers that send no workerId (board, legacy TUI, bare CLI) behave exactly as today, including the 'by unknown' notice.
ActivityEvent.workerId was already optional; existing activity.log lines and .moe/ state need no migration.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Pass params.workerId at the four call sites. Chosen; identical to d981e0b0. (2) actors.actor in release_task: rejected, because it records 'unknown' for a caller-less release (DoD 1). (3) comment.author or amendment.amendedBy: rejected, because they carry the 'agent' and 'unknown' placeholders. (4) An assignee fallback inside updateTask or appendActivity: rejected. appendActivity deliberately never guesses, since a governor's move would then be recorded as the worker. (5) Normalizing '' to undefined: deferred. The review-loop tools pass '' through too, and the right place is appendActivity, which is another file and a shared surface.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: updateTask(..., event, actorWorkerId) is the single actor channel for task events. It feeds both the activity event's workerId and the #general 'Task moved to X by Y' notice (actorWorkerId || assignee || 'unknown'). release_task clears the assignee in the same write, so without the actor every status move it causes reads 'by unknown'. releaseTask.ts has two WORKER_RELEASED writes: :249 is the already-unassigned repair, which may auto-route WORKING to REVIEW; :332 is the assigned path, which may route to REVIEW or, through the refusal cascade, to BACKLOG. amend_plan_step's role gate already refuses a missing id, so its actor is always real. add_comment's author defaults to 'agent', which must not become the actor. The architect validated the whole plan in scratch: RED on 946358a8 (9 failing checks), GREEN with the fix (6 files, 109 tests), 7 of 7 mutants killed, and the exact gate command at exit 0.
planningNotes.risks: (1) Formatting drift from fix.diff breaks mutants.sh's regexes; it reports NOT APPLIED rather than a false kill. (2) Shell-writing the test into the tree makes the path HELD at landing (rail 3). (3) Running npm ci or npm test in the shared checkout breaks the live runtime (rail 1). (4) Out-of-scope lookalikes: unblock_worker's workerId is the TARGET seat, so passing it would misattribute; the board comment path has no seat id; the daemon-owned writes have no caller. (5) A peer landing tests in the same files changes the 109 count; exit 0 is the bar.
